substantive_reconstruction.operative_counter_model: Cost=Op->Nat with eight categories field,sqrt,angle,trig,compare,read,write,emit. Run.pure has zero cost; Run.bind adds actual executed ledgers. A stored entry lookup reads a row reference and then its scalar entry, exactly2 tick(read). collect retains supplier work and bills2 reads+2 writes per output index. Nesting collect for N rows and M columns adds the (NM+N) surcharge, including outer row-reference traffic even when M=0. Therefore E(N,M)=2NM tick(read)+(NM+N)(2tick(read)+2tick(write)) is an exact identity for these transpose/extraction suppliers, not a universal claim that arbitrary callbacks are free.
substantive_reconstruction.one_by_one_emit_witness: Take m=n=1 and the stored zero matrix. The actual rectangular sweep starts at k=0 with one column and sees k<N. Its columnSweep count is N-1-k=0, so it returns the unchanged matrix and empty list at zero cost, emitting no step. The rest sweep is empty; appending an empty prefix emits nothing. identity1 uses comparisons/materialization only. replay[] charges one end-marker read and no emit. Transpose, extractR and extractQ have only read/write costs. Consequently wide.emit=0. By the exact declared polynomialBudget branch, P(1,1).emit=1*1=1, whereas all E terms have emit0. Thus the proposed equality fails as0!=1 for this actual routine, even though its upper bound is valid. No optimality lower bound or alternative elimination algorithm is used.
substantive_reconstruction.stronger_trace_crosscheck: Independently unfolding the same definitions gives actual C(At) at one-by-one: compare2, read5, write4 and all other counters0. One comparison comes from the sole sweep column and one from identity1; replay supplies the extra read. E(1,1) is read6+write4. There are three such materializations, so actual wide cost is compare2+read23+write16 (scalar total41), with field/sqrt/angle/trig/emit all0. These symbolic counts follow from the producer definitions, not a new kernel or numerical execution. The candidate needs only the emit discriminator and does not falsely claim all-zero data are a free run.
substantive_reconstruction.exact_stage_identity: Let At=(transpose A).value, and let result be the single actual StoredRectangularGivens.compile At output. Unfold wide's four binds: cost(wide A)=cost(transpose A)+cost(compile At)+cost(extractR result.reduced)+cost(extractQ result.transform). The value-independent exact materialization equalities turn this into E(n,m)+C(At)+E(m,m)+E(m,n). The final pure Factors constructor adds no counter. This is an identity for the actual intermediate At/result, not a sum of unrelated certificates or a rerun producing a different transform.
substantive_reconstruction.inequality_step: The compiler theorem is universal in its actual stored input X and counter op, so it applies to this At at dimensions(n,m). Add the same nonnegative E terms to C(At)<=P(n,m), counterwise. This gives the claimed wideBudget inequality. Nothing permits changing <= into equality; source compileBudget_eq proves equality of two budget expressions, not equality of actual compiler cost with those expressions. The new question and answer keep these levels separate.
substantive_reconstruction.same_run_matrix_bridge: Write B=denote(result.reduced) and T=denote(result.transform). Stored compile_reduced/compile_transform identify exactly these values with the deterministic rectangular residual/steps transform. The chronological replay of the same recorded log gives B=T*A^T. Each recorded ordered plane is orthogonal, so T^T*T=I_n, and recovery T^T*B=A^T follows. Thus, on transposing recovery, A=B^T*T. This order matters: Q contains prefix rows of T, not T^T. The source retains actual matrix/log consistency through the changing-matrix sweep; no external existential factor is substituted.
substantive_reconstruction.prefix_factorization_and_triangularity: For i<m,j<n, expand (B^T*T)(i,j)=sum_{k<n} B(k,i)T(k,j). The residual is zero when column i<row k. Every k>=m has i<m<=k, so its term vanishes. Restrict the finite sum to k<m and define R(i,k)=B(k,i), Q(k,j)=T(k,j), exactly the stored extraction formulas. Then A=R*Q entrywise. In fact R(i,k)=0 for k>i by the same residual property, so the factor is lower triangular. There is no rank-pivot selection or discarded nonzero tail in this restriction.
substantive_reconstruction.orthonormal_rows: T is square n-by-n, so over the reals T^T*T=I_n implies T*T^T=I_n as well, including n=0. Q consists of the first m rows, and (Q*Q^T)(i,j)=sum_{k<n} T(i,k)T(j,k)=(T*T^T)(i,j)=delta_ij for i,j<m. Hence Q*Q^T=I_m. Its row count is m, not rank(A); rank deficiency belongs to R and does not invalidate orthonormal rows of Q.
substantive_reconstruction.deficient_zero_and_empty_cases: Zero or repeated rows require no new hypothesis. The source angle has an explicit zero-norm branch, and a zero pair produces an identity step without division by zero; structural sweeps may still emit zero-angle steps at larger dimensions. At m=0, A is0-by-n, R is0-by-0 and Q is0-by-n; all factorization/row-identity entry obligations are empty. The transpose still stores n empty rows: E(n,0)=2n(read+write). The rectangular compiler on n-by-0 performs no sweep, materializes I_n and reads the empty replay end marker. Its exact ledger is n^2 compare+(2n^2+2n+1)read+(2n^2+2n)write. Thus the full m=0 wide run costs n^2 compare+(2n^2+4n+1)read+(2n^2+4n)write; it is not generally free. At n=0, m<=n forces m=0, leaving one end-marker read and no other costs. None of these residual empty costs emits a record.
substantive_reconstruction.dispatcher_and_resource_boundary: StoredThinLQ.compile is the all-shape dispatcher and always adds tick(compare). On a wide shape it executes this wide body plus that extra comparison; wide itself does not contain it. On a tall shape compileBody uses the original A and materialized I_n instead, outside the new wide question. Counts concern the declared stored exact-real producer, including rows/logs; they do not establish finite-precision runtime, numerical stability, Clifford+T cost, gate optimality or a local formal companion for every sentence.
